requirement: make_reset_run output contains a '---' separator line
rationale: AVL requires the exact run-case format; missing fields produce silent zero-value substitutions

requirement: Case name encodes the geometry name
rationale: Name appears in AVL output and helps correlate .st files to source geometry

requirement: Alpha and beta are mapped to their respective AVL variables
rationale: Unmapped variables default to zero in AVL silently ignoring sweep inputs

requirement: All named controls are assigned to their respective variables
rationale: Unmapped controls default to zero in AVL silently ignoring requested deflections

requirement: CDoref is written into the run case
rationale: Ensures viscous drag is included consistently across all cases

requirement: CG coordinates (Xref, Yref, Zref) are written into the run case
rationale: Moment coefficients and neutral point depend on the reference CG position

requirement: Unit strings are written when Lunit/Munit/Tunit are provided
rationale: Physical units affect dimensional output quantities

requirement: Geometry with no controls produces a valid run block without control lines
rationale: Wing-only runs must not emit malformed control assignments

requirement: Stdin command script begins with LOAD <avl_file> to load geometry
rationale: AVL is driven entirely via stdin; LOAD must precede PLOP and OPER to initialize geometry before sweep commands

requirement: Stdin command script loads the run-case file via CASE <run_file> before OPER commands
rationale: CASE initializes run-case variables from reset.run; without it AVL uses uninitialized defaults

requirement: Graphics are disabled via PLOP followed by G
rationale: Suppresses interactive plot windows that would block AVL in headless or CI environments

requirement: Script opens the OPER menu
rationale: All run execution and output saving commands are issued inside OPER

requirement: Script ends with Quit
rationale: Without Quit the AVL subprocess hangs waiting for further input

requirement: Each run case sets alpha and beta via A A and B B direct assignments
rationale: Direct assignment bypasses AVL trim logic and uses the specified flight condition exactly

requirement: Each run case saves a .st file to out_dir
rationale: Output files are the only persistent artifact of each AVL run

requirement: Each run case executes (i), saves (st), and resets (x then CINI) before the next
rationale: CINI clears accumulated forces; omitting it causes subsequent results to inherit prior state

requirement: Control sweep emits Di Di <defl> commands for each surface and deflection value
rationale: Incorrect Di index or deflection value silently runs a different flight condition

requirement: Multiple alphas produce one run block each
rationale: Batches the full alpha sweep in a single AVL invocation

requirement: Alpha and beta values appear verbatim in the A A and B B assignment commands
rationale: Formatting errors or rounding in the command string would silently run a different flight condition

requirement: Reset run block initialises alpha to 0.0
rationale: The reset case must start from zero so subsequent A A commands apply from a known baseline

requirement: mode defaults to independent and produces a byte-identical command script whether passed explicitly or omitted
rationale: Backward compatibility: existing callers must see no behavior change

requirement: mode=independent sweeps each surface one at a time, never setting two Di variables in the same case
rationale: Matches original MATLAB behavior; each case isolates a single surface's effect on the aero coefficients

requirement: mode=combinatorial emits one case per element of the Cartesian product of all swept surfaces' deflection lists
rationale: Case count must match the full combinatorial space so downstream tables/analysis account for every combination

requirement: mode=combinatorial sets every swept surface's Di variable simultaneously within a single case
rationale: AVL's OPER menu supports setting multiple Di variables before running a case; this is what makes a run genuinely combinatorial rather than independent

requirement: mode=combinatorial includes the all-neutral (every surface at 0.0) case
rationale: The shared neutral point is required for total_stab/stab_deriv/ctrl_deriv tables to populate

requirement: make_run_command raises ValueError with message containing not recognised for an unrecognised mode
rationale: Fails fast with a clear error rather than silently defaulting to a mode the caller did not request
